prompt: Serializer options leak between builds: after building one serializer with { largeArraySize: 2, largeArrayMechanism: 'json-stringify' }, a serializer built later WITHOUT options still uses JSON.stringify for arrays (so integer items like 1.5 come out unrounded). Each build should use only its own options.
requirement: largeArrayMechanism and largeArraySize given to build() affect only the serializer built in that call. A build without them uses the defaults (mechanism 'default', size 20000), whatever earlier builds used; a build that sets only one of them gets the default for the other. Serializers already built keep the behaviour they were built with.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: a build with no options after a json-stringify build rounds integer array items ([1.5, 2.5] → [1,2])
a build that sets only largeArrayMechanism uses the default size 20000, not an earlier build's size
a build that sets only largeArraySize uses the default mechanism
the serializer built with json-stringify keeps that behaviour

adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit; behaviour outside the requirement is not graded.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev split only)
provenance.notes: Real behaviour of fast-json-stringify v7.0.1 (largeArraySize/largeArrayMechanism are module-level and never reset).
